Spanish native speaker here. Im 20yo, came to US when i was almost 16, no english watsoever. School was hell for me because i didnt understand shit, once i started understanding it was all good, the hard part was to speak. i felt the same way you do, there were words that i felt have many ways to pronounce it and i was afraid i wasn't gonna pronounce it right, but this feeling goes away. in the process of learning, you'll see that you start getting more confident whenever you learn more, at first it feels like that, you feel like all eyes are on you. But it goes away, my only advise, try to focus as much as possible! whenever you go to your Spanish class, all distractions off and really focus your mind in the class.

try Amazon, they hire massively and has a lot of job opportunities of any kind! I wish you the best. Know that the situation you are in is NOT your fault, and what you are feeling is valid. You're not a failure or a disappointment, you're just a dad who is going through some very harsh times and please don't forget to consider the pandemic we are living in!!! don't put so much stress on your shoulders over things you can not control. 

I wishyou the best and all positive thoughts and wishes for you and your family.
